idle.scope: 主进程 + XPC 辅助进程 + 子进程合计

compare.scope: 同一台机器同期60秒；两者按各自当前配置运行。轻仪CPU/内存2秒、磁盘60秒；Stats CPU/RAM/Disk默认1秒。不是同功能、同刷新频率评测。

data: 安装版；菜单收起，CPU/内存每2秒、磁盘每60秒；启动后静置45秒，M4/16 GiB 当前日常负载

idle.scope: 主进程 + XPC 辅助进程 + 子进程合计

speed_gui.label: 进程内首个 CPU 数值（单次）
speed_gui.label_en: First CPU reading after app setup (single run)
speed_gui.method: AppDelegate 初始化至首个有效 CPU 差分；非完整冷启动；含1秒采样窗口

speed_cold_start.reason: 本轮保留用户正在试用的菜单栏，未反复关闭应用做完整冷启动统计。

why: 原生 AppKit；无第三方运行依赖和网络请求；CPU/内存共用2秒采样器，磁盘容量缓存60秒；数值变化时才重绘。
why_en: Native AppKit; no third-party runtime or network requests; shared 2-second CPU/memory sampling, 60-second disk-capacity cache, redraw only on visible-value changes.
data_en: Installed build, menu closed, 56-point compact status item; 2-second CPU/memory and 60-second disk updates. Settled at least 45 seconds before a 60-second CPU window; footprint sampled separately afterward.

targets.note: CPU 为初始优化目标；以 idle.cpu_pct 的实际值判定，不把目标写成实测。

menu_bar.layout: CPU上下两行，内存与磁盘各一根竖条

verification.cli: Installed CLI JSON and errors verified
verification.ui: Real panel rendered offscreen; 0/22/100 percent compact indicator checked on light/dark backgrounds
verification.native_ui: CUA read timed out; actual menu clicking and real sleep/wake cycle not automated in this session
